title: Penthouse Magazine September 1987 Madonna Special Anniversary Issue
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, September 1987 — Special Anniversary Issue, featuring "Madonna: All-New Nudes" (10-page pictorial), Pet of the Month Stephanie Page, plus features on Ronald Reagan, a Rock Hudson's-lover interview, and pieces from James A. Michener, Dashiell Hammett, and the Beastie Boys.
Complete issue, no missing pages noted. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
